# graviteeam_entrypoints (Data Source)

Reads entrypoints from a Gravitee AM domain

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_entrypoints" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain to read entrypoints from

### Read-Only

- `entrypoints` (String) JSON string containing the entrypoint definitions
